summary: House of Doge Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that its wholly-owned subsidiary, Dogecoin Ventures, issued a $1.4 million unsecured subordinated short-term note to lender Devlin DeFrancesco. The note matures July 27, 2027, with 10.714% annual interest, repayable via 2,227,300 CleanCore Solutions (ZONE) shares, subject to prior repayment of the senior Yorkville Loan. The filing also disclosed a change in certifying accountant. This is a financing obligation, not a classic special situation; the share-based repayment adds an unconventional element. Watch for repayment mechanics and Yorkville Loan status.
